stemMd: Which monitoring plan best reflects the passage?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Record weather and habitat conditions alongside counts and distinguish trends under comparable conditions from absolute cross-site comparisons.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Treat every instrument upgrade as evidence of population growth.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Ignore animal behavior as unrelated to measurement.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Use the highest count from each site as its exact population.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Merge camera and visual counts without noting the transition.

explanationMd: The plan makes detection conditions visible and matches claims to the evidence. It preserves useful monitoring while avoiding unsupported equivalence between different methods or habitats.

distractorRationale.e: That conceals the change in detection.
distractorRationale.d: A maximum sighting total is not complete enumeration.
distractorRationale.c: The passage explicitly links the two.
distractorRationale.b: That repeats the initial mistaken inference.
